Fantech Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions

Effective Date: 14 January 2024

Thank you for participating in the Fantech Affiliate Program. These Terms and Conditions outline the guidelines and rules governing your participation in the program. By joining the Fantech Affiliate Program, you agree to comply with the terms outlined below.

1. Eligibility:

1.1 Geographical Scope: Affiliate sales counted for commission purposes are intended for purchases made on www.fantechworld.com only. Eligible regions include the United States, Japan, Canada, Vietnam, Singapore, Mexico, South Korea, New Zealand, Malaysia, Australia, Israel, Chile, Colombia, United Kingdom, Europe, and South Africa.

1.2 Exclusion of Other Regions: For regions not specified above, including but not limited to Brazil, affiliates are encouraged to direct their audience to the AliExpress affiliate program or other local marketplace affiliate programs. Registration for these programs can be initiated via [marketing@fantechworld.com].

2. Affiliate Sales:

2.1 Eligible Transactions: Commissionable sales are restricted to transactions completed on www.fantechworld.com within the specified eligible regions.

2.2 Exclusions: Sales originating from regions outside the specified list are not eligible for commission through the Fantech Affiliate Program.

3. Commission Structure:

3.1 Calculation: Commissions will be calculated based on eligible sales as specified in Section 2.

3.2 Payment: Fantech will process affiliate payments in accordance with the terms outlined in the Privacy Policy. All affiliate sales will be accumulated by the 30th day of each month and processed within a week.

4. Marketing and Promotion:

4.1 Promotional Materials: Affiliates are provided with approved marketing materials for use in promoting Fantech products. All promotional activities must adhere to applicable laws and regulations.

4.2 Misrepresentation: Affiliates are prohibited from misrepresenting Fantech products, making false claims, or engaging in any deceptive marketing practices.

5. Termination:

5.1 Violation of Terms: Fantech reserves the right to terminate an affiliate's participation in the program if there is a violation of these terms and conditions or if the affiliate engages in unethical or fraudulent activities.

6. Changes to Terms and Conditions:

Fantech reserves the right to modify these Terms and Conditions at any time. Affiliates will be notified of any significant changes via email or through the affiliate dashboard.

7. Contact Information:

If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding these Terms and Conditions, please contact us at [marketing@fantechworld.com].

By participating in the Fantech Affiliate Program, you acknowledge that you have read and understood these Terms and Conditions and agree to comply with them.
